verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect pieces of a sandbox workflow. Infrastructure Manager supports preview deployments that show how changes would affect infrastructure before they are applied. IAM gives fine-grained control over who can act on which resources, which could wall off production, and the free tier and $300 credit support proof-of-concept experimentation. Missing for 10: a documented isolated sandbox or test environment (e.g., separate sandbox projects or emulators), any mechanism for testing against non-production or synthetic data, guidance on separating agent testing from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
